messages.subject: Matthew | Director-Level MENAT Executive | Government Affairs, ESG & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Matthew,

I am reaching out directly because your current remit leading Talent across HSBC MENAT sits squarely within the region where I am pursuing my next senior leadership mandate.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate and external affairs, executive communications and cross-functional stakeholder execution for a major gold-mining operation. Earlier, I spent five years with Scotiabank in a regulated financial-services environment.

The combination gives me a cross-sector profile suited to roles where business growth depends on government relationships, regulatory judgement, institutional trust and disciplined execution. My strongest targets are Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates across Corporate Affairs, Government Affairs, External Affairs, ESG, Strategic Partnerships, Country Leadership and related functions across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar and wider MENAT.

I am internationally mobile, hold an MBA, have completed executive development in China and the UAE, and have a 30-day notice period. I would value your consideration for current or upcoming HSBC mandates, or for a referral to the relevant regional executive hiring lead where my profile fits.

I have attached a MENAT-tailored executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
